chars.A: AMINE: a tall slim young man wearing a fitted light-blue dress shirt with rolled sleeves, navy slim trousers, a brown leather belt and a red bank employee badge on a lanyard.
chars.S: SALMA: a confident young woman wearing a bright burgundy blazer over a cream blouse, a long black skirt, gold hoop earrings and a small black handbag.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a modern open-plan bank office in Casablanca. AMINE sits at his desk looking very awkward and leaning away, while SALMA leans over his desk far too close, one hand on his chair, smiling flirtatiously at him. Two colleagues in the background stare in shock. Comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a chic Casablanca restaurant with warm lights. AMINE and SALMA sit face to face at a small candle-lit table having dinner, SALMA laughing and leaning forward, AMINE smiling politely.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same restaurant table. SALMA rests her chin on her hand and gives a sly scheming side glance with a mischievous grin, while AMINE innocently eats his food without noticing anything.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, inside a car driving through Casablanca Finance City with tall glass towers lit up outside. SALMA drives confidently with a satisfied smile, AMINE in the passenger seat looking out of the window, slightly puzzled.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night street in front of a luxurious modern residential glass tower with a doorman and palm trees in Casablanca. SALMA walks ahead proudly, AMINE follows behind looking up at the building, impressed and a bit nervous.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night sidewalk near the luxury tower. AMINE stops and raises his hands asking a question with a confused face, SALMA turns back toward him, smiling and pointing toward the building entrance.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: In front of the elevator in the marble lobby of the tower. SALMA happily pulls AMINE by the arm toward the open elevator, AMINE leans back hesitating with a nervous sweaty face. Comic awkward mood.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside a very luxurious modern apartment with big leather sofa, designer furniture, chandelier and a huge window over the city lights at night. AMINE stands in the middle with his mouth wide open, amazed, while SALMA drops her handbag on a table, smiling.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Apartment entrance hallway. SALMA stands with her back against the closed front door, turning the key to lock it with a mischievous grin. AMINE in front of her freezes in shock with wide eyes, sweating. Comic tense mood.
